Browse repositories, install packages, and keep your tweaks updated on iPhone and iPad.

## Features

- Add repositories from links and move your repository list between devices with import and export.
- Search packages, repositories, and authors.
- Read package pages in light or dark mode.
- Install any version a repository offers, or block updates for packages you want to keep.
- Buy paid packages and sign in to your vendor accounts.
- On roothide, install simple rootless tweaks with Compatibility Mode.
- Rebuild icons and reload the Home Screen from Settings.
- Update Irisin from inside the app.

## Compatibility

Requires iOS or iPadOS 16 or later with supported custom firmware. Choose `iphoneos-arm64e` for roothide or `iphoneos-arm64` for rootless. Install the matching official package; do not convert Irisin with a compatibility patcher.

Available in 19 languages.
